rationale: Reallocate the recurrent-tail fp16 export rescue from the first recurrent K matrix to the matching V matrix while keeping the final recurrent K rescued. This is byte-neutral because K and V have the same shape, preserves the winning reverse-tail curriculum and quant-aware endgame, and tests whether final int8 roundtrip error is more sensitive to recurrent value transport than to the earlier tail key projection.
title: Byte-Neutral Tail Value FP16 Reallocation
